sql: select split_part(market_ticker,'-',1) series, coalesce(live_outcome,'-') live, coalesce(twin_outcome,'-') twin, count(*) n, count(distinct market_ticker) mkts from live_paper_parity_events where twin_tag='Hmmsell10_pt4' and split_part(market_ticker,'-',1) in ('KXFEDMENTION','KXRAIN','KXTRUMPSAY','KXTRUMPSAYCOMPANY','KXTRUMPSAYMONTH','KXWCATTEND','KXWCFIRSTSONG','KXWCMENTION') group by 1,2,3 order by 1,4 desc
